parts.text: Does this set show biodiversity of living things in that field patch?

options.text: Yes, because it lists different plants and animals found in that patch.
No, because earthworms and squirrels cannot count toward biodiversity.
Yes only if she also adds whales from a distant ocean to the same list.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Charu lists peepal sapling, marigold, earthworm, myna, and squirrel from one patch of the school field.

part_answers.answer: Biodiversity of a place is the variety of living plants and animals that belong there; her list shows several living kinds from that field patch.

teacher.key_rationale: Variety of living plants and animals in a region is biodiversity. Distant ocean animals are outside that place; living kinds in the patch do count.
